profiles.docs: Four documented adapters: InMemoryFs, OverlayFs, ReadWriteFs, MountableFs.
profiles.sourceFinding: Root source exports all four; IFileSystem is asynchronous, with readFileBuffer/writeFile/stat/chmod etc. Overlay supports readOnly configuration; read/write adapter is explicit host-root access. MountableFs composes adapters. No S3/WebDAV adapter files in the inspected src/fs tree; a custom IFileSystem is not an out-of-box provider qualification.

profiles.docs: Library network is off by default; README separately says interactive shell enables network by default.
profiles.sourceFinding: Bash registers curl when network OR a supplied SecureFetch exists. Supplied fetch replaces createSecureFetch: a fake SecureFetch cannot establish the built-in redirect/authorization policy. Built-in fetch checks URL/method policy and manages redirects/body bytes; curl consumes a completed Uint8Array body, not the target response-iterator API.

profiles.docs: Opt-in js-exec advertises JS/TS, require/import, VFS fs/path/process and other Node-like shims.
profiles.sourceFinding: js-exec.ts dispatches to js-exec-worker.js via Node worker_threads; worker imports quickjs-emscripten and creates guest context/shims. This is QuickJS WASM, not SafeJS and not Node. Node-named command is the refusal stub. Memory/deadline statements are source/docs claims only, not measured containment.

profiles.docs: No zero-runtime-dependency claim established by inspected README.
profiles.sourceFinding: Published metadata and source package.json declare 16 dependencies and 2 optional dependencies; Node >=20.18.1. Optional feature activation is distinct from package dependencies. No dependency count establishes safety or performance.

ExecResult has string stdout/stderr, stdoutKind/text-or-bytes and legacy stdoutEncoding. Public Bash logResult decodes valid UTF8 byte-shaped strings, while VFS readFileBuffer is byte-native. ExecOptions stdin is string with stdinKind; no AsyncIterable stdin API equivalent to target counters. Freeze a per-row terminal representation adapter, never generically UTF8-roundtrip unknown bytes or pretend host prebuffering is product consumption.

specificSourceFindings.finding: sed stores -e scripts immediately and appends all -f scripts afterward; interleaving order deserves actual testing, no predicted result counted.
-i.bak sets only inPlace=true; in-place branch writes the original path without creating the named backup. Expected backup is a concrete source-level gap, not an observed failure.
-s is not in accepted short-option characters and routes to unknownOption.
rg chooses stdin only when decoded stdin length>0; explicit-empty provenance is not equivalent to target stream API. Exact decoy fixture is valuable, but no runtime result inferred.
curl parser has no -D/--dump-header branch; -D goes to unknownOption. Keep frozen output/header oracle; do not remove -D to make a synthetic pass.
